2) Week 1: SIG/CAIQ complete + gap log populated; DPA initial redline exchange.
3) Week 2-3: Evidence upload (SOC artifacts) + security walkthrough with Soojin.
4) Week 4: Legal sign-off on DPA + docu-sign route.

Alice — can you confirm: 1) internal FinTera evidence owner for SOC 2 artifacts, and 2) which region (us/eu) needs the retention annex? That will alter our recommended hosting variant.

Thanks — simple next step: reply with owners and any immediate blockers, otherwise we’ll schedule a 30-minute walkthrough early next week.
